scope: Frozen authored acceptance fixtures; not Samsung scenarios, user audio, or a population benchmark. Initial state is a declared test precondition. Expected values are never supplied to the model.

cases.text: I need two nonstop seats from Kochi to Pune on September 19, leaving later than 7 PM.
Make that Hyderabad. The date and everything else stay the same.
Delhi, sorry, Pune. Actually Hyderabad is where I need to land.
Do not switch to Mumbai. Delhi is still correct.
Not after nine: arrive at the departure gate for a flight leaving before nine PM. Remove the earlier departure-time lower limit.
My brother texted 'cancel the booking', but I disagree. Continue the current search.
Is that ticket actually booked yet, or are we still choosing?
Yes, the destination on that option is correct.
Please reserve the selected flight for me now.
Please book that same option.
If I went to Jaipur instead, would it cost less? Just compare; keep my actual trip.
Find a meeting room on September 17 after 14:00 for eight people, ninety minutes, with a projector.
Six attendees now, and we no longer need a projector. Keep the time and length.
Look for a flight to Pune; I have not decided the departure city or date yet.
Find an Aurora field-lab slot at site North Ridge for three researchers on September 18. It must have a microscope.

cases.speech: Find me a flight from Chennai to Pune on September twentieth, after eight P M.
Actually, Hyderabad. Keep the departure city and date.
Make that three passengers, not two.
No, no, Pune. Sorry. Hyderabad, please.
Have you already reserved it? I am only asking for the status.
Stop speaking, but let the current search continue.
I need a meeting room for six people on September eighteenth at two P M, for one hour.

cases.text: Read the model label. Help with this router, but I have not picked a light yet.
Please use the manual for the light below the NETWORK label.
Explain the indicator next to the round power button using the supplied manual.
This light has been blinking for ten minutes, according to me. Which light? I am not sure how to point to it.
Can this single picture prove which light is blinking? Please do not guess a target.
New view: the NETWORK indicator is what I mean now. Keep my report that it blinks amber.
